name: recording-device-login-frames

graded_by.test: core/internal/record/login_write_test.go — TestADeviceLoginsFramesAreInterleavedWithTheirStampsNeverDecreasing (with an empty prompt, L9): the frames above in this order, code 8 `login as:` first, in exactly the x-login-line bytes
core/internal/session/device_login_test.go — TestWithTheKnobOffNothingOfTheDeviceLoginIsHeldOrRecorded: no byte of the user name, the prompts or the answers is in either file, the knob off

description: A device login's frames on disk, sidecar codes 6, 7 and 8 (a keyboard-interactive login; a password round's code-8 `Password:` is in recording-device-login-own-prompt). With policy.yaml recording.login_input on at start, `recording.enabled` on, and `recording_acknowledged` true on the create, the session's recording opens with these frames, in this order, each stamped on the core's input clock when the core received it, the clock never decreasing: (1) code 8, TSB's own `login as:`, then code 7, the user name typed at it, both stamped when the create arrived; (2) code 6, the banner, if one came; (3) for each keyboard-interactive round, code 6 for `name` then code 6 for `instruction`, each when not empty, then code 6 for a prompt's text and code 7 for its answer, interleaved; a prompt with empty text is written as the tag alone, so every answer follows its own prompt's frame, and a prompt written after an earlier answer of its round carries that answer's stamp, since the clock never decreases; (4) for a password round, code 8, TSB's own `Password:`, then code 7, the answer (the frames of one are in recording-device-login-own-prompt); (5) the host-key decision is not recorded: it is audited. A code-6 frame is text the device sent, and TSB's own prompt text is code 8, so no code-6 line can carry TSB's words; the keyboard-interactive round has no code-8 frame. The bytes here are the knob-on case, and the knob-off case (nothing of the device login is held or recorded) is the core's own test. Refused: a login frame after any other frame, and a prompt stamped before the answer it follows. The answers are the synthetic constant.

invalid.note: a code-6 frame after an output frame: login frames are the head of the recording
a prompt stamped before the answer of its own round: the input clock never decreases

invalid.problem: not the login line of its code
invalid.note: a raw escape sequence in device text: the line is one printable row
